title: Claw
wikitext:
'''Claws''' is an [[item class]] of one-handed [[melee]] [[weapons]] that require [[intelligence]] and [[dexterity]], have a moderately high base [[critical strike chance]], high base [[attack speed]] and have a {{c|mod|Grants X Life per Enemy Hit}} or {{c|mod|x% of Physical Attack Damage Leeched as Life}} [[implicit]] [[modifier]]. 

[[Maraketh weapon]]s with this item class have a {{c|mod|Grants X Mana per Enemy Hit; Grants X Life per Enemy Hit}} [[implicit]] instead.
